Added a second refactor in `reindex-management`, this time in the request layer. The shared `TaskId` storage, stream serialization, and validation plumbing now lives in [AbstractReindexTaskRequest.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G002_elasticsearch/modules/reindex-management/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/reindex/management/AbstractReindexTaskRequest.java:22), and both [GetReindexRequest.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G002_elasticsearch/modules/reindex-management/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/reindex/management/GetReindexRequest.java:19) and [CancelReindexRequest.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G002_elasticsearch/modules/reindex-management/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/reindex/management/CancelReindexRequest.java:18) now only handle their endpoint-specific fields and messages.

I also added [GetReindexRequestTests.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G002_elasticsearch/modules/reindex-management/src/test/java/org/elasticsearch/reindex/management/GetReindexRequestTests.java:20) to cover the get-request validation path, which previously had no dedicated test. `git diff --check` passed.
